timepoints.comment: Phase 1, from the pull (all three runs to a tenth: 2.1, 2.2, 2.1 s): Tumult round him, then every 10.25 s (2.1, 12.4, 22.6, 32.9 in the Duty Support run)
Rock Buster on his target (the tank) 8.3 s in, every 10.25 s (8.3, 18.5, 28.8)
Phase 2, from his being targetable again after the first Geocrush (the director's): Tumult 2.1 s on (all three), then every 18.6 s
Landslide (2.7 s, a line before him) 13.5-13.6 s on
The Heart's phase, from the Heart of the Mountain (his line 3801, the director's): Rock Throw on someone other than his target 7.8-7.9 s on, once (the director's gaol follows)
Landslide 14.0-14.3 s on, then every 22.6 s (36.8 in the Duty Support run)
Rock Buster 28.5 s on (the Duty Support run's; the Heart fell before it in the other two)
Phase 4, from his being targetable again after Earthen Fury (his line 3803): Tumult 2.1 s on, then every 41.0 s (43.0, 84.0 in the Duty Support run)
Weight of the Land (2.7 s on himself; the director's helpers mark the ground under two of the party) 8.2-8.3 s on
Rock Throw 32.9-33.1 s on (the director's gaol follows)

comment: Titan in the Navel (BNpcBase 246, layout 4039257, level 34, 25124 HP). From Bob's Chronofoil captures 650dbfd8 (Duty Support), 0fd8bce0 and 48aaf6fe (Duty Finder) of 2026-11-06, `questkit chronofoil --battle`: numbers only. His phases begin as the director says (content/s1fa_re.lua: restart_timeline): his Geocrushes at 80 and 50 %, the Heart of the Mountain, Earthen Fury. Recorded amounts: the medians of all three runs' hits on players (the tanks' for Rock Buster and his auto-attack) and on the Duty Support members; Geocrush weaker further from the middle, where he lands (by_distance: 17 hits fitted to a line). The hitbox (3.7) is a guess: the Duty Support Marauder fought him from 6.7 yalms, and Ifrit (3.5) from 6.5. Cactbot's titan-nm timeline has other times and thresholds (85 and 55 %); these are the runs'.
